title: Material Simulation Task Schema
description: Schema for defining tasks in material simulations using LLM agents.

task_prompt.description: Detailed description of the task, including instructions for the agent.

task_properties.description: Key-value pairs defining the properties of the task. These can vary depending on the task.

tools.description: List of tools required to complete the task.

subtasks.description: List of subtasks that make up the task.

tools.description: List of tools required to complete the subtask.

submission_format.description: Expected format for the subtask submission. Can be null if no specific format is required.

initial_input.description: Initial input required for the subtask. Can be null if no input is required.

scoring_fn.description: Name of the scoring function used to evaluate the subtask.

input_from_task.description: List of subtask IDs whose outputs are required as input for this subtask. Can be null if no input is required.

ground_truth.description: List of ground truth data for the subtask.

type.description: Type of ground truth data (e.g., file_path, lammps_config, numerical_result).

data.description: Key-value pairs representing the ground truth data.
